description_en: Lists the instances in my application group
kebab_example: aliyun cms list-my-group-instances --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --total true --group-id 4728420 --category ecs --keyword aliyun --instance-ids i-hp3dunahluwajv6f0000 --api-version 2018-03-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListMyGroupInstances

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to display the total number of records. Valid values:

true: Displays the total number of records.
false: Does not display the total number of records
parameters.help_zh:
是否展示总记录条数。

true：展示总记录条数。

false：不展示总记录条数
parameters.name: total

parameters.help_en:
The application group ID.

How to obtain: Call the ListMyGroups operation to query the list of existing application groups under the current account to obtain a valid GroupId.

Alternatively, call the CreateMyGroup operation to create a new group and obtain the returned ID.

Do not directly use the sample values in the documentation to avoid call failures due to insufficient permissions
parameters.help_zh:
应用分组 ID。

获取方式： 可调用 ListMyGroups 接口查询当前账号下已有的应用分组列表以获取有效的 GroupId；

或调用 CreateMyGroup 接口创建新分组后获取返回的 ID。

请勿直接使用文档示例值，以免因无权限导致调用失败
parameters.name: group_id
